title.zh-CN: 急性咯血与严重低氧 · 31岁男性
title.en: Acute haemoptysis and severe hypoxaemia · man aged 31

summary.zh-CN: 严重低氧和贫血伴双肺磨玻璃，轻微尿异常也可提供肺肾病因线索。
summary.en: Severe hypoxaemia and anaemia with bilateral ground glass require attention to even subtle urinary clues.

notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

reviewers: AI-assisted editorial source and guidance check; not a licensed clinician
guidelines: KDIGO. Clinical Practice Guideline for IgA nephropathy and IgA vasculitis. 2025; kidney diagnosis, not a specific recommendation for this rare pulmonary presentation. https://kdigo.org/guidelines/iga-nephropathy/

notes.zh-CN: 已对照所列权威资料进行人工智能辅助编辑核对；未由执业医师审核。原报告罕见表现及方案仍需专科确认。
notes.en: AI-assisted editorial check against the cited authorities, not licensed-clinician review. Rare presentations and source regimens still require specialist confirmation.

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别低氧、贫血和肺影的出血组合。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise the haemorrhagic combination of hypoxaemia, anaemia and infiltrates.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解释肌酐正常不能排除重要肾病。
learningOutcomes.en: Explain why normal creatinine does not exclude relevant kidney disease.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 区分肾病确证与肺出血归因。
learningOutcomes.en: Distinguish renal confirmation from pulmonary causal attribution.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 立即处理低氧和失血风险，同时保留病因不确定性
learningOutcomes.en: Address hypoxaemia and blood-loss risk immediately while retaining causal uncertainty

chiefComplaint.zh-CN: 咳嗽咯血气促1周，发热2天
chiefComplaint.en: One week of cough, haemoptysis and dyspnoea with two days of fever

triageNote.zh-CN: 入院未吸氧SpO₂68%，需立即升级呼吸支持评估。
triageNote.en: Room-air SpO₂ was 68% on admission, requiring immediate respiratory escalation assessment.

text.zh-CN: 肺泡出血综合征并评估肺肾关联及感染
text.en: Alveolar haemorrhage with pulmonary–renal and infectious assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 失血证据与影像需要结合，而非仅按肺炎。
feedback.en: Bleeding evidence and imaging need integration beyond pneumonia.

text.zh-CN: 发热就足以确定全部为普通肺炎
text.en: Fever establishes ordinary pneumonia as the sole cause

feedback.zh-CN: 不能解释全部出血和重度贫血。
feedback.en: It does not explain all bleeding and severe anaemia.

text.zh-CN: 肌酐正常即可停止尿和肾病评估
text.en: Normal creatinine ends renal assessment

feedback.zh-CN: 重复血尿提示仍需肾脏评价。

text.zh-CN: 肾活检确证IgA肾病，肺出血关联为综合临床判断

feedback.zh-CN: 不能把肾免疫荧光变成未做的肺病理。
feedback.en: Renal immunofluorescence is not unperformed lung histology.

text.zh-CN: 血IgA升高本身特异确证IgA肾病

feedback.zh-CN: 组织证据才提供重要定位。

text.zh-CN: 所有抗体阴性就排除免疫相关出血

feedback.zh-CN: 有限筛查不能穷尽病因。

feedback.zh-CN: 重度低氧不能等诊断步骤全部完成才升级。

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 用日常语言说明证据：识别低氧、贫血和肺影的出血组合。同时解释以下信息仍有缺失或疑问：肺组织、完整肺泡灌洗、长期肺肾结局和其他病因排除。请对方复述关键内容以确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain the evidence in everyday language: Recognise the haemorrhagic combination of hypoxaemia, anaemia and infiltrates. Identify the following as missing or uncertain: Lung tissue, complete lavage, long-term pulmonary/renal outcomes and exclusion of other causes. Check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: IgA肾病伴严重肺泡出血的临床关联，肾组织证据明确而肺病因证据有限。
conclusion.en: A clinical association of IgA nephropathy and severe alveolar haemorrhage, with definitive renal but limited pulmonary causal evidence.

boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

testUtterances.text: 咯血和气短从什么时候开始？
When did haemoptysis and breathlessness begin?
痰里是血丝还是有血块？
Is the sputum streaked with blood or does it contain clots?
发热是先出现还是咯血后出现？
Did fever precede or follow the haemoptysis?
最高烧到多少度？
What was the highest temperature?
用了抗感染药后有没有好转？
Did antibiotics improve the illness?
复查胸片或CT是变好还是变重？
Did follow-up imaging improve or worsen?
有没有关节痛或新出的皮疹？
Have you had joint pain or a new rash?
除了肺部不舒服，皮肤关节有变化吗？
Have skin or joints changed alongside the chest symptoms?
平时做什么工作，有粉尘烟雾吗？
What work do you do, and is there dust or fume exposure?
工作时有没有接触焊烟？
Is there welding-fume exposure at work?
有没有吸烟或饮酒？
Is there smoking or alcohol use?
烟酒的用量和时间有记录吗？
Are amounts and duration of smoking or alcohol recorded?
以前身体怎样，有哪些病？
What was health like before this illness?
既往有没有需要治疗的疾病？
Were any earlier illnesses treated?
以前有没有药物过敏方面的情况？
Could you describe any medicine allergies?
以前有没有家族病史方面的情况？
Could you describe any family illnesses?
以前有没有既往手术方面的情况？
Could you describe any earlier operations?
以前有没有日常用药清单方面的情况？
Could you describe any regular medicines?
